gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: I can't stand ___ kept waiting when I have an appointment.
gaps.explanation: 'Can't stand' takes a gerund; the passive gerund is 'being kept'.

gaps.sentence: The burglar admitted ___ through the kitchen window.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit' is followed by a gerund: admitted climbing.

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.
